# 020 — wp2 pipeline: goat-nightly.yml, keychain notarization, verify, publish, prune

Depends on wp1 (constants, version, guard). Re-verify anchors at cycle start. Builder: lanes may be split (workflow + mac signing by main; scripts by a gpt-6.1-sol worker in its own worktree).

## 1. `.github/workflows/goat-nightly.yml` (NEW)

Audit r1 blockers 1–4 shaped this section.

```yaml
name: goat-nightly
on:
  workflow_run: { workflows: [goat-ci], types: [completed], branches: [dev] }
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      sha: { description: "dev commit to build (default: dev tip)", required: false, type: string }
permissions: { contents: read }
# No workflow-level concurrency: cancelling a run must never cancel its publish job.
```

Every job checks out the verified SHA itself (`actions/checkout@v6`, `ref: needs.prepare.outputs.sha`, `clean: true`, sparse `/*` + `!/.repos/`, `persist-credentials: false`), so nothing depends on a persistent EPYC or Mac workspace. "Setup" below means `voidzero-dev/setup-vp@v1` (`node-version-file: package.json`, `cache: false` on self-hosted) then `vp install --filter=@t3tools/desktop... --filter=t3... --filter=@t3tools/scripts...` and `node scripts/update-release-package-versions.ts "$version"`.

Environment bindings (audit r2 new blocker 1). Values are literal unless marked; no step outside `publish` references `secrets.`.

| Where                                                  | Variable                                                   | Value                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| every desktop build step                               | `T3CODE_DESKTOP_UPDATE_FEED_ENABLED`                       | `true`                                                                                          |
| every desktop build step                               | `T3CODE_DESKTOP_UPDATE_REPOSITORY`                         | `goat-si/goat-releases`                                                                         |
| every desktop build step                               | `T3CODE_DESKTOP_PAYLOAD_REPORT`                            | `${{ github.workspace }}/reports/verify-desktop-<platform>-<arch>.json` (§5)                    |
| Mac desktop build, Mac CLI build, `finalize-macos-dmg` | `APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE`                                   | `goat-notary`                                                                                   |
| same                                                   | `APPLE_KEYCHAIN`                                           | absolute login keychain path written by preflight into `$GITHUB_ENV` (no expression)            |
| same                                                   | `T3CODE_REQUIRE_NOTARIZATION`                              | `1`                                                                                             |
| Mac desktop build                                      | `T3CODE_APPLE_TEAM_ID`                                     | `U9ATA49N28`                                                                                    |
| Mac jobs (from preflight via `$GITHUB_ENV`)            | `CSC_NAME`, `CSC_KEYCHAIN`, `T3CODE_CLI_MAC_SIGN_IDENTITY` | resolved identity by team; keychain path                                                        |
| Windows/Linux desktop and CLI                          | `T3CODE_DESKTOP_SIGNED`                                    | `false`                                                                                         |
| `publish` steps after token creation                   | `GOAT_RELEASES_TOKEN`                                      | `${{ steps.app_token.outputs.token }}` (the `create-github-app-token` step has `id: app_token`) |
| `publish` prune step                                   | `GOAT_PROTECTED_TAGS`                                      | `${{ vars.GOAT_PROTECTED_TAGS }}`                                                               |
| `prepare`                                              | `GH_TOKEN`                                                 | `${{ github.token }}`                                                                           |

Build jobs (`js_bundle`, `cli`, `desktop_*`) carry job-level `concurrency: { group: goat-nightly-<job>-<matrix key>, cancel-in-progress: true }`, so a newer run cancels an older run's builds and the older run's `assemble`/`publish` never start (their `needs` fail). `assemble` and `publish` have no cancelling group; the publish script's monotonic check (§6) stops an older run that already passed assemble from going backwards.

Every job except `prepare` starts its `if` with `needs.prepare.result == 'success' && needs.prepare.outputs.skip == 'false'`; `assemble` adds `&& (!cancelled() && needs.cli.result == 'success' && needs.desktop_mac.result == 'success' && needs.desktop_other.result == 'success' && needs.desktop_linux_x64.result == 'success')`, and `publish` adds `&& (!cancelled() && needs.assemble.result == 'success')`. `assemble` and `publish` list `prepare` in `needs` explicitly. The gate on `prepare` is exactly:

```yaml
if: >-
  github.repository == 'goat-si/goat' &&
  (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
   (github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
    github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
    github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'dev' &&
    github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == 'goat-si/goat'))
```

A PR-origin goat-ci completion has `event == pull_request` and is refused here; the guard (010 §7) enforces that this exact gate exists and that every other job depends on `prepare`.

Limits stated plainly: `workflow_dispatch` runs the workflow file from the dispatched ref, so anyone with write access who can push a branch could craft a dispatch that targets the Mac runner; the pre-push guard is advisory (`GOAT_SKIP_WORKFLOW_GUARD`, `--no-verify`). Hard enforcement is a GitHub-side setting: a runner group for the Mac Studio restricted to `goat-si/goat/.github/workflows/goat-nightly.yml@refs/heads/<default branch>` (user task; requires an org plan with selected-workflow runner groups) and a required reviewer on the `goat-releases` environment.

## 2. Desktop notarization (MODIFY `scripts/build-desktop-artifact.ts`)

Near the env assembly (~:4284-4307), for `signed && platform === "mac"`:

- If `APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE` is set: delete `APPLE_API_KEY`, `APPLE_API_KEY_ID`, `APPLE_API_ISSUER`, `APPLE_ID`, `APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD` from the build env (builder precedence, N-7).
- If `T3CODE_REQUIRE_NOTARIZATION=1` and none of {profile, API key trio, Apple ID trio} is complete: fail with `DesktopNotarizationCredentialsMissingError` before packaging.
- Unit-test the pure helper `resolveMacNotarizationEnv(env): { env, problem? }`.

## 3. DMG finalize (NEW `scripts/finalize-macos-dmg.ts`)

Electron-builder notarizes and staples the .app before creating the DMG/ZIP. It signs a DMG only when \`dmg.sign === true\` (\`dmg-builder/out/dmg.js:44\`), which GOAT does not set (\`build-desktop-artifact.ts:2957\`), and it never notarizes a DMG. For each `*.dmg` in `--dir`: `codesign --sign "$T3CODE_CLI_MAC_SIGN_IDENTITY" --timestamp <dmg>`, `xcrun notarytool submit <dmg> --keychain-profile goat-notary [--keychain $APPLE_KEYCHAIN] --wait --output-format json` (require `status == "Accepted"`), `xcrun stapler staple <dmg>`, then rewrite the DMG entry's `sha512` and `size` in the arch's `nightly-mac*.yml` (via `scripts/lib/update-manifest.ts` parse/serialize) and regenerate or delete the stale `.dmg.blockmap` (mac updates use the ZIP). Pure manifest-rewrite helper unit-tested.

## 4. CLI notarization (MODIFY `scripts/build-cli-archive.ts:285-370`)

- Config adds `APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE`, `APPLE_KEYCHAIN`; flag `--require-notarization` (and env `T3CODE_REQUIRE_NOTARIZATION`) threaded from the command (~~:567) to signing (~~:522).
- Auth args: profile first (`--keychain-profile <p> [--keychain <k>]`), else API trio; with require mode, ad hoc identity or no credentials → fail.
- Submit a zip of the whole content directory written **outside** it (`$TMPDIR/goat-notarize-<pid>.zip`; today's zip sits inside the content dir, `build-cli-archive.ts:349`) (`ditto -c -k --keepParent <contentDir> <zip>`), `--output-format json`, parse and require `status === "Accepted"`; on failure fetch `notarytool log <id>` into the error.
- Pure helper `notarytoolAuthArgs(config)` + status parser unit-tested.

## 5. Verifier (NEW `scripts/verify-release-artifacts.ts` + `scripts/lib/release-verify.ts`)

Every report is `{ key, mode, version, inputs: [{ name, sha256 }], ok, checks[], problems[] }`. `inputs` lists only **distributable payload artifacts** — DMG, ZIP, NSIS `.exe`, AppImage, DEB, CLI `.tar.gz`/`.zip` — never manifests, blockmaps or `builder-debug.yml`, which later steps legitimately rename, merge, regenerate or delete (manifests are instead checked against final bytes by `assemble`). For Mac, the builder payload report covers the ZIP (unchanged after build) and records the pre-finalize DMG hash; `finalize-macos-dmg.ts` appends a `transforms: [{ name, from, to, step: "dmg-finalize" }]` entry for each DMG it signs, notarizes and staples, and the post-finalize `mac` verifier report lists the final DMG/ZIP hashes. `assemble` accepts a report only when its `version` equals `--version`, its `key` is expected, and every input hash equals the final asset hash either directly or through one recorded transform whose `to` equals the final hash and which is itself covered by a passing `mac` report for that asset; so an unrelated `ok` report or a substituted binary fails. Blockmaps: the stale `.dmg.blockmap` is deleted by finalize (mac updates use the ZIP); ZIP and Windows blockmaps are unchanged and are checked only through manifests and SHA256SUMS. Test (`scripts/lib/release-verify.test.ts`): builder report → DMG finalize transform → manifest rename + merge → assemble passes; the same chain with one substituted ZIP or DMG fails.

- **Builder payload hook (audit r2 blocker 11).** `scripts/build-desktop-artifact.ts`, after `validatePackagedSshRuntimeArchives` (~~:4392) and before the copy loop (~~:4401), when `T3CODE_DESKTOP_PAYLOAD_REPORT` (or `--payload-report`) is set: run `scanReleasePayload(stageDistDir)` from `scripts/lib/release-verify.ts` over the real staged tree — `mac/*.app` / `mac-arm64/*.app`, `linux-unpacked`, `linux-arm64-unpacked`, `win-unpacked`, `win-arm64-unpacked` — then hash the produced artifacts in `stageDistDir` into `inputs` and write the report; fail the build on problems. The stage directory is still present at that point, so nothing needs to be retained.
- **Exposure scan** (`scanReleasePayload`, shared by the builder hook, `payload` and `mac`): walk the given tree. Inside, open every `*.asar` (`@electron/asar` listPackage/extractFile, already a builder dependency) including `app.asar` and any `server.asar`, walk `*.asar.unpacked`, and untar embedded SSH/WSL runtime archives (`*.tar.gz` under resources). Fail on: `*.map` files; `sourceMappingURL=data:`; `"sourcesContent"`; original sources (`*.ts`, `*.tsx`, `*.mts`, `*.cts` except `*.d.ts` in `node_modules`); `.git/` entries; absolute build paths (`/Users/<name>/`, `/home/runner/`, `/opt/actions-runner/`, `D:\\a\\`, `C:\\a\\`, `$GITHUB_WORKSPACE`); `github.com/goat-si/goat` not followed by `-releases`/`_`. A small allowlist covers dependency license texts and known third-party path literals, each entry with a reason.
- **`mac --dir --team [--require-signing]`**: mount each DMG (`hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly -mountpoint <tmp>`, always detached), unzip each ZIP (`ditto -x -k`), untar CLI archives; classify every file by its first 4 bytes as Mach-O (`feedface`, `feedfacf`, `cefaedfe`, `cffaedfe`; fat `cafebabe`/`bebafeca` only when the next big-endian u32 is 1–20, which excludes Java class files). With `--require-signing`: each Mach-O passes `codesign --verify --strict` and `codesign -dvv` shows `TeamIdentifier=<team>`; each `.app` passes `codesign --verify --deep --strict`, `spctl -a -vv -t exec`, `xcrun stapler validate`; each DMG passes `codesign --verify`, `spctl -a -vv -t open --context context:primary-signature`, `xcrun stapler validate`. Without it (dry run) unsigned files are listed, not fatal. Then the exposure scan.
- **`payload --dir`**: exposure scan of CLI archive contents on any OS.
- **`assemble --dir --reports --version`**: required asset set (N-9) present and nothing unexpected; every manifest's `version` equals `--version` and every `files[].url` exists with matching `sha512` and `size`; reports complete and ok; then writes `SHA256SUMS` over every other asset (sorted, `<hex>  <name>`) and re-reads it.
  Pure helpers (Mach-O magic, exposure patterns, manifest checks, sums writer, report gate) are unit-tested in `scripts/lib/release-verify.test.ts`; the mac mode is exercised for real in the wp4 dry run.

## 6. Publish (NEW `scripts/publish-nightly-release.ts` + `scripts/lib/github-releases.ts`)

`github-releases.ts`: small fetch client with token from `GOAT_RELEASES_TOKEN` and an injectable `fetch`; every list call paginates (`per_page=100`, follow `Link: rel="next"`); retries 5xx and secondary-rate-limit 403/429 with backoff; asset upload to `uploads.github.com`.
Publish algorithm (idempotent, resumable, byte-verified; audit r1 blocker 9). Local truth is `SHA256SUMS` plus the sha256 of `SHA256SUMS` itself.

1. List all releases. If a **published** release has tag `v<version>`: compare its assets to local (names, sizes, sha256 via the asset `digest` field, or download-and-hash when `digest` is absent). Identical → `outcome=already-published`, exit 0. Different → exit 1 ("tag already published with different bytes").
2. If any published nightly has a higher version (`compareSemverVersions`) → `outcome=superseded`, exit 0.
3. Find or create the **draft** `v<version>` (`target_commitish: main`, `prerelease: true`, `make_latest: "false"`, name from `--name`, body from `renderReleaseNotes`: version, UTC date, per-platform file table, "macOS signed and notarized; Windows and Linux unsigned — verify with SHA256SUMS"; no commit messages or PR links).
4. Reconcile draft assets: delete any asset not in the local set or whose sha256 differs; upload missing ones; re-list and require every name, size and sha256 to match (download-and-hash if `digest` missing).
5. Sync `install.sh`, `install.ps1`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` into goat-releases `main` through the contents API when the git blob SHA differs (one commit per file, message `chore: sync <file> for v<version>`). This is the only path that writes those files; the workflow never pushes git.
6. Re-run step 2's check; if superseded now, leave the draft and `outcome=superseded`. Else PATCH `draft: false`; re-read the release and require `draft == false`, `prerelease == true`. `outcome=published`.
   `--dry-run` performs only reads and prints the plan. Unit tests with a fake fetch: fresh publish; resume after partial upload (one wrong-digest asset replaced, one extra deleted); superseded before and after upload; already published identical; already published different; pagination across two pages; missing digest → hash path.

## 7. Prune (NEW `scripts/prune-nightly-releases.ts`)

Runs only after `outcome=published`. Policy (D-11): keep the newest 30 published nightlies, every published nightly younger than 30 days, every non-nightly release (stable/preview), every draft, the release the current feed points at (the newest published nightly — already inside "newest 30", asserted explicitly), and every tag in `--protect` (comma/newline list from repository variable `GOAT_PROTECTED_TAGS`, used for bootstrap and rollback releases). Feed references inside older releases are not needed: electron-updater falls back to a full download when the old version's blockmap is gone (050 §11). Delete selected releases (release first, then `git/refs/tags/<tag>`); orphan nightly tags with no release that are older than the policy window are deleted on the next run, which covers a failed tag deletion. Pagination as in §6. `--dry-run` prints the plan. Pure `selectReleasesToPrune(releases, tags, now, policy)` unit-tested (protected tag, draft, stable, boundary at exactly 30 days/30 items, orphan tag).

## Proof

`vp test run` for every new/changed test file; `actionlint .github/workflows/goat-nightly.yml` (installed to a temp dir, not the system); guard accepts the workflow (`node .vite-hooks/goat-workflow-guard.mjs <sha> refs/heads/goat/release-nightly` with GOAT_DISABLED_WORKFLOWS from `gh api`); targeted typecheck of scripts.
